content.short: Empowering Creators in Web 3 with AdaLink Affiliate Network.
content.description:
AdaLink is a blockchain-based Affiliate Network built on Cardano. Our platform streamlines the management of partnerships by connecting stake pool operators and Cardano businesses with creators, influencers, NFT founders, and marketers. This connection maximizes visibility for users' pools, products, and services by facilitating promotional efforts.

Leveraging blockchain technology, AdaLink ensures transparent and accurate tracking of conversions and rewards, providing a trustworthy and efficient system for all affiliates.
